decision.reasoning_trace: I was browsing for a reliable portable Bluetooth speaker. My consideration set included a variety of options: the high-end Edifier 2.1 system for home use, the premium portable JBL Go 3, and several mid-range rugged speakers. I excluded several products from consideration immediately because they were actually carrying cases or cables rather than the speakers themselves. I ultimately chose the EDUPLINK speaker because it offered the best balance of features (20W power, IPX7 waterproofing, and RGB lighting) and proven customer satisfaction with over 9,000 reviews, all while being priced competitively under $30. While the Raymate offered slightly more wattage, the EDUPLINK's massive review base provided more confidence in its long-term performance.
